description: This file provides utilities for handling file consent and info cards in MS Teams, including building consent and info card attachments, parsing file consent invoke activities, and uploading files to consent URLs.

methods.name: buildFileConsentCard
methods.description: Builds a FileConsentCard attachment for requesting upload permission in MS Teams.

methods.name: buildFileInfoCard
methods.description: Builds a FileInfoCard attachment to confirm upload completion.

methods.name: parseFileConsentInvoke
methods.description: Parses a fileConsent/invoke activity, returning a structured response or null.

methods.name: uploadToConsentUrl
methods.description: Uploads a file buffer to the provided consent URL using HTTP PUT.
